verdict.rationale: Google Drive exposes a well-documented REST API (auth scopes, uploads, permissions, push notifications, properties) and even guidance for building AI agent add-ons with ADK/Vertex AI Agent Engine, which supports building AI-native integrations. However, the evidence pack never cites official language-specific client libraries/SDK pages (e.g., Python, Node, Java SDKs) — only the raw REST reference — and probes show no llms.txt/openapi discovery files, indicating limited AI-native tooling support. Missing for 10: explicit official SDK/client-library documentation, machine-readable API spec (openapi.json/llms.txt), and independent developer confirmation of SDK quality.
